sources.title: Chapter 3 Design
sources.verified_claim: London Plan Chapter 3 includes Policies D11 and D12 on safety, security, resilience and fire safety, requiring development proposals to integrate emergency and evacuation considerations; policy does not establish parcel-specific fire risk or permission.

sources.title: Fire Safety LPG (2022)
sources.verified_claim: City Hall's Fire Safety LPG page explains how applicants should demonstrate compliance with London Plan fire-safety and evacuation-lift policies; guidance status and application requirements are not parcel-specific outcomes.

sources.title: Your London Fire Brigade: our plan for 2023-29
sources.verified_claim: London Fire Brigade's 2023-29 Community Risk Management Plan sets London-wide priorities informed by its Assessment of Risk; service planning is resilience context and not evidence of a sample parcel's risk or development capacity.

sources.title: Assessment of Risk 2025 - Foreword and Section 1
sources.verified_claim: LFB's Assessment of Risk 2025 describes London-wide foreseeable fire and rescue risks and informs prioritisation; London-level risk assessment does not quantify exact parcel risk.

sources.title: Assessment of Risk 2025 - Detailed report
sources.verified_claim: The detailed 2025 LFB assessment separates public concern, property/place risk, extraordinary risk and emerging future trends; these layers are not treated as direct measurements of the sample parcels.

sources.title: Enfield Borough Risk Management Plan
sources.verified_claim: LFB's Enfield Borough Risk Management Plan describes borough-specific risks and protection priorities; borough risk planning is context and does not establish the fire-risk state of parcel_30762.

sources.title: Havering Borough Risk Management Plan
sources.verified_claim: LFB's Havering Borough Risk Management Plan sets borough-level risk and protection priorities; it is not parcel-specific evidence for parcel_46142.

sources.title: Lambeth Borough Risk Management Plan
sources.verified_claim: LFB's Lambeth Borough Risk Management Plan sets borough-level risk and protection priorities; it is not parcel-specific evidence for parcel_61522.
